_about: How World's ground-contact events (docs/world/ground-contact.md section 4) shape the poses (render/anim/anim_fighter.gd, on_ground_event). surface: a multiplier on the bounce's crumple and pose weight by the surface class (World's proposed bounceMul: paving and rock lively, sand and rubble dead). bounce and launch: the speed (the event's vn, its spd) that gives the pose its full weight, and the least weight it gets. hold: the brace of a tumble: in and out times (s), weight the share of the pose it is (about half, so the ragdoll's flail shows through, as Orb asked: fighters ragdolled, skidding, tumbling, bounced), slow_k and fast_k the multiplier below slow_speed and above fast_speed of the landing (firmer at low speed, looser at high), worn_loosen how much a worn fighter (wear or brink above worn_from) loosens it, max the cap. getup: the wear (or brink) above which the get-up is the slow one. Render only, outside the sim's data hash.
